candidate.statement: For every finite simple tree T, domination_number <= (((2/3 * order) + 1/3) + (-1/3 * diameter)).

proof_resolution.short_diameter: For n>=2 and 2D<=n+2, Ore gamma<=floor(n/2) implies 3gamma+D<=2n+1.
proof_resolution.long_diameter: For 2D>=n+2, Gu-Meng-Zhang-Wan 2013 Lemma 2.3 gives gamma<=n-D+ceil((2D-n-1)/3); 3ceil(x/3)<=x+2 implies the candidate.
proof_resolution.coverage: For integer D, the two regimes cover every nontrivial tree; the even boundary belongs to both.
